rules.title: California Civil Code section 1947.12 (Tenant Protection Act rent cap, SB 567)
rules.requirement: An owner of residential real property may not raise gross rent more than 5 percent plus the local percentage change in cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, in any 12-month period, with no more than two increases in that period. The initial rent for a new tenancy is not capped.
rules.key_value: 5% plus CPI change, capped at 10% (whichever is lower), per 12 months
rules.penalty: Civil action for injunctive relief, actual damages, attorney's fees and costs, and up to three times the excess for willful, oppressive, fraudulent or malicious conduct. The Attorney General, city attorney or county counsel may also enforce.
rules.status_basis: Effective January 1, 2024; operative April 1, 2024 by its own provisions; repealed as of January 1, 2030 by its own provisions (Stats. 2023, Ch. 290, SB 567).

exempt_if.name: deed_restricted_affordable_housing
exempt_if.text: Housing restricted by deed, regulatory agreement or other recorded document as affordable housing, or subject to an affordable housing subsidy agreement

exempt_if.name: dormitory
exempt_if.text: Dormitories owned and operated by an institution of higher education or a K-12 school

exempt_if.name: local_rent_control_stricter
exempt_if.text: Housing subject to local rent or price control that restricts annual increases to less than the amount in subdivision (a)
Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome
Residential real property that is alienable separate from the title to any other dwelling unit

exempt_if.name: owner_not_REIT_corporation_or_LLC_with_corporate_member_and_notice_given
exempt_if.text: Owner is not a REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management, and tenants were given written exemption notice
Property containing two separate dwelling units within a single structure

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: Owner occupied one unit as principal residence at the start of the tenancy and continues in occupancy; neither unit is an ADU or JADU

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental housing in California not otherwise exempt.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing, dormitories, housing under stricter local rent control, housing with a certificate of occupancy within 15 years, certain separately alienable homes with non-corporate owners, and owner-occupied duplexes.

precedence.text: This section shall not apply to housing subject to rent or price control through a public entity's valid exercise of its police power consistent with Chapter 2.7 that restricts annual increases in the rental rate to an amount less than that provided in subdivision (a).

rules.quoted_span: Subject to subdivision (b), an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
